feedback: Say what the caller reported: electrical burning smell, smoke thickening near the copy room, no flames seen, alarm not sounding. The crew needs this first, and your message leaves it out.

Remove the details that aren't in the building record: the 119 people above, the wind and smoke drift, and 'wet' sprinklers. Stating invented facts as real can mislead the crew. Give only what the data supports, such as sprinklers: yes.

Add what the crew needs on floor 7. Name the tenants (Bunker Steel, Condon & Company, Luxury Homes Realty, Triton International) and note the freight elevator on record. Also give the exit signs the scan shows and the pull stations. Don't say 'NOT KNOWN' about exits when the scan shows 3 exit signs.
